description: High-power LED constant-current driver based on PT4115. The circuit accepts a 12V-24V input supply and drives a 1W LED at 350mA using a buck constant-current topology. The design requires an input bypass capacitor, a high-side current-sense resistor between VIN and CSN, a switching freewheeling path from SW, and proper grounding of both the GND pin and exposed pad.

verification_assertions.desc: Ground unification: PT4115 GND pin and exposed pad must share one common ground net.
Critical net isolation: VIN, CSN, SW, and GND must all reside on mutually distinct nets.
Unified ground net must carry Ground electrical attribute.
Input supply rail feeding PT4115 must carry Power electrical attribute.
A current-sense resistor must be inserted between VIN and CSN to set the regulated LED current.
The PT4115 SW node must have a valid freewheeling path for buck LED drive operation.
The PT4115 input rail must have a low-ESR bypass capacitor to ground.
